senses.en_definition: A person's fate, fortune, or circumstances, whether good or bad.

messages.en: Good thing you asked the driver to wait earlier. Otherwise, I'd have missed the bus!
I saw you running from way off. Leave a bit earlier tomorrow so you won't have to chase the bus again.
I wanted to ask you for a bit of advice about tomorrow's interview.
Just relax. You've prepared, right? Just answer honestly.

senses.en_definition: A politically sovereign community with its own government; a state or nation.
A country considered as a geographical area or territory.

messages.en: Are you planning to go abroad this holiday?
Nah, just travelling within the country this time. I'm thinking of going to Penang with my family.
Which state do you want to visit this weekend?
Perak. I've already booked a room in Ipoh.
